verdict.rationale: Loops documents a first-party POST /events/send endpoint that sends an event to trigger workflows, and its workflow docs say events start published workflows built around product events. Per-contact targeting is implied by its contact model (contacts keyed by email or userId) but not stated explicitly for events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an event is scoped to a single contact identifier, details on defining custom event names or properties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fire a custom event from my product and have it trigger an automation for exactly that person

citations.quote: POST /events/send Send an event to trigger workflows
Send events to start published workflows.
Build onboarding, trial, and re-engagement workflows around your product events.
PUT /contacts/update Update a contact by email or userId
